reader_summary.overview: Hi everyone and welcome to Investing by the Books, a podcast by Red Eye. I'm your host, Nicola Servos, and next to me is my friend and colleague, Eddie Palmgren. Today, we have the great pleasure and honor of speaking to the legendary Richard Lawrence.

thesis: The podcast introduces Richard Lawrence, founder of Overlook Investments, who has delivered an annual return of 14.3% since founding the firm in 1991. The discussion centers on Lawrence's book, 'The Model,' which details the firm's investment philosophy and business practices as it celebrates its 30-year anniversary.
